visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged male narrator with black-framed glasses and a black button-down shirt speaks directly into the camera. He is positioned in front of a densely packed bookshelf filled with books and various collectibles. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting his animated facial expressions. His hands are visible, making various explanatory gestures to emphasize his speech. (2) A transition occurs to an AI-generated image showing five scientists in white lab coats falling down in a laboratory while a man resembling Barack Obama stands to the right. This is followed by a real photograph of four young people posing with Obama in a formal room with historical portraits. The background shifts between a simulated lab and a formal administrative office. (3) Brief clips of animals and animation appear: a group of penguins on an ice shelf, one penguin slipping, a cartoon character falling down a flight of stairs in a suburban house, and a pigeon with a security camera mounted on its head walking on pavement. These are interspersed with shots of the narrator gesticulating in his room. (4) 3D graphics show a house interior with green Wi-Fi signal rings and a moving human silhouette. Then, a real man is shown in a tech lab with motion tracking on a monitor. Another clip shows monitoring footage of a person falling in a living room, with the word FALL displayed in red text. (5) A 3D model of a house is shown with green matrix-style code overlays, then a blue hexagonal grid shield forms around it. The final shot returns to the narrator in his initial setting, showing a look of exaggerated surprise. A small inset video shows a Shiba Inu's head stuck in a stone wall.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a male speaker delivering high-energy Mandarin narration in a clear, professional tone. A mid-tempo electronic BGM with a bright, rhythmic synthesizer beat begins immediately. The speech is fast-paced, and the recording quality is studio-clean with no audible background noise. (2) A digital 'whoosh' sound effect occurs during the first visual transition. The narrator's voice remains dominant as he asks a rhetorical question. The BGM maintains a steady, driving energy around 125 BPM, emphasizing the upbeat and informative nature of the track. (3) A sequence of incidental sound effects is heard: a distinct sliding noise and penguin chirping, followed by a cartoonish 'thud' and a record scratch. These effects are intentionally placed to match the visual humor of falls. The narrator continues talking through these events without pausing. (4) Digital UI 'blip' sounds and scanning effects are introduced during the technical explanation of Wi-Fi waves. A heavy percussive 'thud' occurs exactly when the person in the video falls. The music and speech maintain a high-arousal energy level as the benefits for the elderly are described. (5) Shimmering digital 'matrix' sounds and a rhythmic shield-activation SFX play during the 3D graphics segment. The speaker's tone becomes slightly more teasing and conversational at the end. The electronic BGM swells for a final flourish before a quick fade-out.
